nodes.title: Scarlet Night
nodes.description: Player character. Connected by blood to the slain Regent; her mother's unsolved murder is tied to the deeper mystery beneath the city. Currently the target of an assassination plot.

nodes.title: Mazza Stoneclaw
nodes.description: Player character. Heir to the Stoneclaw estate, whose family history holds hidden clues, including an encoded painting left behind by the Regent.

nodes.title: Malachi Thorne
nodes.description: Player character. An archivist with ties to the Mages Tower, recently drawn into a dangerous conversation with a devil offering an open contract.

nodes.title: Firzen Tor
nodes.description: Player character. Driven by a personal vendetta that has made him a target for manipulation by outside forces.

nodes.title: Allegra Bardeau
nodes.description: Player character, part of the party investigating the succession crisis and its hidden currents.

nodes.title: Regent Cerulean "Ciri" Night
nodes.description: The assassinated Regent whose death triggered the succession crisis. Left behind a series of encoded landscape paintings hiding critical secrets.

nodes.title: Cardinal Titus Trenico
nodes.description: A respected Abadarian priest and prominent voice in the Church faction during the succession crisis. Publicly a moderate, rational influence on the city's politics.

nodes.title: Zusi Absolom
nodes.description: A Diabolist contact who recruited the party into a dangerous scheme involving the imprisoned mage Sam Szimani.

nodes.title: Eiloron
nodes.description: A figure entangled with Sam Szimani's imprisonment, wary of disturbing whatever binds the Old City's secrets, and at odds with Szimani over how to proceed.

nodes.title: Lia Owale
nodes.description: President of the Guildhead council. A leading suspect in the Guild's apparent connection to the Conclave attack.

nodes.title: General Thao Veng
nodes.description: A military leader implicated by circumstantial threads in the unfolding conspiracy around the Conclave attack.

nodes.title: Janus Sinclair
nodes.description: A recurring figure in the city's political undercurrents.

nodes.title: Aethel Auberge
nodes.description: Revealed to be a vampire; responsible for turning Lieutenant Ewan. Her family's fate is entangled with the assassination plot against Scarlet.

nodes.title: Evie Auberge
nodes.description: A figure whose survival hangs on whether the party can intervene in time during the plot against Scarlet Night.

nodes.title: Lieutenant Ewan
nodes.description: A city officer secretly turned into a vampire by Aethel Auberge.

nodes.title: Archivist Senne Carrath
nodes.description: Malachi Thorne's superior, connected to the Mages Tower and its archives.

nodes.title: Erza
nodes.description: A Deimavigga devil who has extended an open contract offer to Malachi Thorne.

nodes.title: Sam Szimani
nodes.description: An imprisoned mage held in a pocket-dimension prison beneath the Mages Tower. Believes fully investigating Scarlet's mother's murder is the way to lift a lingering curse.

nodes.title: Chihira Sendarme
nodes.description: A halfling orphan and ward of Selwyn Sendarme who has traveled with the party.

nodes.title: Selwyn Sendarme
nodes.description: Guardian of Chihira Sendarme.

nodes.title: Bandit
nodes.description: A mercenary known only by callsign, encountered in the party's investigations.

nodes.title: Graverobber
nodes.description: A mercenary known only by callsign, whose own thread remains unresolved.

nodes.title: Warlock (deceased)
nodes.description: A mercenary known only by callsign. Killed during prior events.

nodes.title: Torturer
nodes.description: A mercenary known only by callsign, part of the roster the party has encountered.

nodes.title: Sapper
nodes.description: A mercenary known only by callsign, part of the roster the party has encountered.

nodes.title: The Nobility
nodes.description: One of the five factions vying for power in the succession crisis following the Regent's assassination.

nodes.title: The Guilds
nodes.description: One of the five factions in the succession crisis. Circumstantial evidence links the Assassins' Guild to the Conclave attack and the land of Tarva.

nodes.title: The Mages
nodes.description: One of the five factions in the succession crisis, centered on the Mages Tower.

nodes.title: The Diabolists
nodes.description: One of the five factions in the succession crisis, operating through contracts and infernal bargains.

nodes.title: The Church
nodes.description: One of the five factions in the succession crisis. Cardinal Trenico is among its most prominent voices.

nodes.title: Tarva
nodes.description: A foreign land increasingly implicated by evidence trails in the Conclave attack, raising the specter of regional war.

nodes.title: Assassination of Regent Ciri Night
nodes.description: The killing that set off the current succession crisis among the city's five factions.

nodes.title: The Conclave Attack
nodes.description: A violent incident increasingly tied to Tarva through an evidence trail, with the Assassins' Guild implicated as the hired hand.

nodes.title: Assassins' Guild Safehouse Discovery
nodes.description: The party traced a Tengu hit squad to this safehouse, uncovering evidence connecting the Guild to Tarva.

nodes.title: Plot Against Scarlet Night
nodes.description: An active, time-sensitive threat to Scarlet's life. Outcomes hinge on whether the party intervenes in time.

nodes.title: Stoneclaw Estate Reunion
nodes.description: Mazza's return to the family estate, where an encoded painting puzzle was discovered.

nodes.title: Aethel Auberge Revealed as Vampire
nodes.description: The party discovered Aethel's true nature and her turning of Lieutenant Ewan.

nodes.title: Malachi's Devil Consultation
nodes.description: A meeting interrupted by Erza's offer of an open contract.

nodes.title: Mages Tower Infiltration (Planned)
nodes.description: An upcoming or in-progress attempt to reach the pocket-dimension prison beneath the Mages Tower to find Sam Szimani.

nodes.title: The Old City (theorized: Goruveah)
nodes.description: A buried, older layer of the city referenced in the encoded painting clues. Its true name is an unconfirmed player theory.

nodes.title: Mages Tower
nodes.description: Seat of the Mages faction, beneath which lies a pocket-dimension prison holding Sam Szimani.

nodes.title: Stoneclaw Estate
nodes.description: Mazza's family estate, site of the discovery of the Regent's encoded landscape paintings.

nodes.title: Assassins' Guild Safehouse
nodes.description: A hideout tied to the Tengu hit squad, containing evidence linking the Guild to Tarva.

nodes.title: Cerulean's Encoded Paintings
nodes.description: A series of landscape paintings that, viewed through a transparent overlay, reveal Old City entrances, the location of the Sword of Sealing, a regent ascension ritual, a numerical sequence, and a partial clue to a forgotten figure's identity.

nodes.title: The Succession Crisis
nodes.description: The overarching political conflict among the five factions following the Regent's assassination.

nodes.title: The Erased Hero
nodes.description: A forgotten founding figure hinted at by a partial initial found in the encoded paintings. Their full identity remains an open mystery to the party.

nodes.title: The Curse
nodes.description: A lingering affliction tied to Scarlet's mother's unsolved murder. Szimani and Eiloron disagree sharply on whether pursuing its cause is worth the risk.

nodes.title: The Diabolist Contract
nodes.description: An unfolding arrangement drawing Malachi toward the Diabolist faction, mediated by Zusi Absolom and complicated by Erza's rival offer.

threads.title: Five Factions, One Throne
threads.description: The Nobility, Guilds, Mages, Diabolists, and Church all maneuver for power after the Regent's death.

threads.title: The Regent's Death
threads.description: Ciri Night's assassination is the spark that ignited the entire current conflict.

threads.title: A Trail to Tarva
threads.description: Evidence recovered at the Guild safehouse points toward Tarva's involvement in the Conclave attack, with the Assassins' Guild as the hired hand.

threads.title: Suspects in the Shadows
threads.description: Owale and Veng have both drawn suspicion in connection with the Guild-Tarva evidence, though neither's guilt is confirmed.

threads.title: A Race Against Time
threads.description: The party is racing to prevent an assassination attempt on Scarlet Night, with Evie Auberge's survival and Scarlet's wellbeing hanging in the balance.

threads.title: Hidden Fangs
threads.description: Aethel Auberge's true nature as a vampire, and her turning of Lieutenant Ewan, ties her family directly into the danger surrounding Scarlet.

threads.title: The Painted Clues
threads.description: The Stoneclaw estate reunion uncovered a hidden overlay within the Regent's paintings, revealing several major secrets at once.

threads.title: Who Was Erased?
threads.description: A partial initial found in the paintings hints at a forgotten founding figure whose full identity remains unknown to the party.

threads.title: A Devil's Bargain
threads.description: Zusi Absolom drew the party into a scheme to reach the imprisoned Sam Szimani, while Erza's rival contract offer complicates Malachi's path.

threads.title: Beneath the Mages Tower
threads.description: The party's plan to breach the pocket-dimension prison and reach Sam Szimani, complicated by Eiloron's involvement.

threads.title: The Hired Guns
threads.description: A network of mercenaries known only by callsign has crossed paths with the party repeatedly, with varying loyalties.

threads.title: Graverobber's Unfinished Business
threads.description: A parallel thread involving Graverobber has been raised but not yet resolved.

threads.title: The Ward Who Travels With Them
threads.description: Chihira Sendarme, ward of Selwyn Sendarme, has accompanied the party through recent events.

threads.title: A Voice of Reason?
threads.description: Cardinal Trenico stands as a prominent, seemingly moderate figure representing the Church faction amid the crisis.

threads.title: An Old Grudge
threads.description: Firzen's personal vendetta continues to shape his choices and draw outside attention.

threads.title: The Archivist's Ledger
threads.description: Malachi's ties to Archivist Senne Carrath connect him to the Mages Tower's deeper resources.
